label: sunburst-numeric-compiled-instrumented

sourceVerification.method: App-relative Vite raw modules/source downloads compared with local bytes
sourceVerification.scope: Representative source files; this does not fingerprint every executed compiled chunk.

limitations: CPU samples and CPU conservative pending deadlines do not measure GPU execution or GPU row start times.
Async read waits overlap; their sums are not a critical-path total. Callers lost across async boundaries stay unresolved.
Historical diagnostic runs without sourceFingerprint must not be assigned later snapshot hashes.
The historical a3667d1d baseline lacks mark lifecycle fades; comparisons with it are behavior-confounded. A later correctness baseline must retain the same fade targets and durations.

focusSamples.limitation: Synchronous sampled call chains only, at most 32 frames; inclusive groups overlap and async resumes may lose their application callers.

geometryProgress.limitation: Changes of sampled drawn x/y bounds, excluding initial geometry; not total fade frames or GPU execution time.
